name: consec_air_carry_pays_phi_of_the_chain_credit_then_refunds_on_landing
description: The car flies level at 1500 uu/s (z 900) into the floating ball and PUSHES it: a push registers a touch on every step of the contact in the engine (frames 8 to 25, 18 steps). Each touch adds credit = ball height x softness x car height x horizontal-speed factor to the effective streak e. In the carry the ball and car move together (|dv| about 5 uu/s, softness 0.9999), the ball sinks from z 806 to about 120 (credit (z-150)/1300 shrinks 0.505, 0.485, 0.464 ... to 0), the car's height credit stays 1 until it falls under 517 uu, and the ball sits about 160 uu ahead of the car (control gate 0.985): e = 0.505 (frame 8), 0.990 (frame 9, under 1: nothing yet), 1.453 (frame 10), 1.893, 2.306 ... saturating at 4.30 by frame 24. Pay: frame 10 pays 0.9969 * Phi(1.453) * gate = 0.19926 (+8.0 at weight 40); cumulative 0.4699 by frame 12, 0.7766 by frame 20, peak +0.7785 (+31.1 weighted). While held it bleeds, and the gate shaves the potential when the ball drifts. The car lands on frame 29 and the whole chain is refunded; the run nets -0.04058 (-1.62 weighted). The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose (a ball set with exactly zero velocity in the air floats: see tools/reward_lab/README.md). Verified independently: a separate script that recomputes the effective streak and the control gate from the exported on-ground, touched, position and velocity values reproduces every step's reward to 1e-7.

expect.intent: the car keeps touching the ball from frame 8 to 25
through frame 9 the effective streak is 0.99, still under 1: nothing is paid
x40 = +8.0 for the first paying touch
landing refunds the whole chain: the run nets only the holding bleed, -0.04058
